info.name: RushCulture
info.description: Rush Culture API — folders by Postgres schema (Core / Master / Meta / Security) plus Common health. Use {{url}} as API base. Staff routes need cookie rc_admin_token from Security/auth/Login (bootstrap user is SUPER_ADMIN). List endpoints support ?page=&limit=. RBAC: Core/access matrix + role permissions; GetMe returns permissions[].
